title: Module Hom homology as homotopy classes
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring and $L,M$ arbitrary integer cochain complexes of $A$-modules [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Let $H$ denote the homotopy-category quotient, identifying chain-homotopic maps. There are additive equivalences $b_{L,M}:\operatorname{Hom}(HL,HM)\simeq H^0(\operatorname{Hom}^{\bullet}_A(L,M))$, for the module Hom complex [def-sc-module-total-hom-complex]. For every chain map $f:L\to M$ there is a cycle $z$ whose inclusion in degree-zero cochains is $\operatorname{ofHom}(f)$ and such that $b_{L,M}(Hf)=\pi(z)$ for the canonical homology projection. No projectivity, boundedness or derived-category hypothesis is required.

source.place: section-hom-complexes, equation-cohomology-hom-complex (15.73.0.1); Mathlib HomComplexCohomology homAddEquiv and leftHomologyData

proof.text: Forget A-module structure using U = forget₂ (ModuleCat A) AddCommGrpCat. The short complex in degree zero becomes definitionally the short complex of Mathlib HomComplex. The forgetful functor preserves homology. For its canonical left homology data D₀, compose U.mapIso D₀.homologyIso, (D₀.map U).homologyIso.symm, and HomComplex.leftHomologyData.homologyIso to identify module homology with CohomologyClass. These are Mathlib homology universal-property isomorphisms.

Apply Mathlib CohomologyClass.homAddEquiv in degree zero and postcompose with the homotopy quotient of the canonical zero-shift isomorphism. Invert this additive equivalence and compose with the inverse of the homology comparison from step 1.

Construct z using HomologicalComplex.cyclesMk on ofHom f; δ_ofHom gives the cycle equation and i_cyclesMk gives its inclusion. The left-homology-data projection and cycles identities show that the homology comparison sends homologyπ z to mk(ofHom f). The kernel inclusion is injective, so the corresponding abstract cycle is ofHom f. Finally compute equivHomShift.symm(ofHom f) followed by the zero-shift isomorphism degreewise; the two shift comparison maps cancel, leaving f. This proves the representative formula.

proof_origin.place: homAddEquiv; leftHomologyData; ShortComplex.LeftHomologyData projection and cycles comparison identities

lean.statement:
theorem moduleHomComplex_quotient (A : Type u) [CommRing A] :
    ∃ b : ∀ (L M : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ),
        ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ _).obj L ⟶
          (HomotopyCategory.quotient _ _).obj M) ≃+
          (moduleHomComplex L M).homology 0,
      ∀ (L M : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ) (f : L ⟶ M),
        ∃ z : (moduleHomComplex L M).cycles 0,
          (moduleHomComplex L M).iCycles 0 z = HomComplex.Cochain.ofHom f ∧
          b L M ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ _).map f) =
            (moduleHomComplex L M).homologyπ 0 z
